none: PAS FindID 956001: Roman Coin: Denarius of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES NER TRAIAN OPTIM AVG GER DAC PARTHICO ; R/ PM TRP COS VI PP SPQR

Silver coin. Denarius of Trajan (98-117), in very fine condition; probably mint of Rome. Exact match not seen in RIC, though this appears to be a variant of RIC vol. 2 page 269 nos. 361/362, early Roman issue of 114-117. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: IMP CAES NER TRAIAN OPTIM AVG GER DAC PARTHICO. Reverse description: Genius standing left…
